title: Do you prefer studying Math or English ?
text:
# Part 1
I strongly prefer studying English rather than math.
There are several reasons to support my opinion.

# Part 2
First of all, English is usually more practical and useful in daily life.
If I improve my English, I am more likely to communicate better at work and in every situations.

# Part 3 
Secondly, I find English more interesting and enjoyable to learn.
For example, in my daily life, I frequently need to reply to emails from international clients and read documents in English./ Studying English not only helps me perform better at work but also allows me to make friends from different cultural backgrounds when I travel abroad.

# Part 4
As a result, I can practice it through movies, music, and conversations, which makes the learning process more fun.

# Part 4 
That’s why I prefer studying English.
